summary.text: Judy Schwank is a Democrat who has represented Pennsylvania's 11th Senatorial District since 2011, serving as Democratic chair of the Senate Agriculture and Rural Affairs Committee and as administrator of the Senate Democratic Caucus.

paragraphs.text: Schwank earned a B.S. and M.Ed. in agricultural education from Penn State University. She worked as a Berks County horticultural agent for Penn State Cooperative Extension, established the Master Gardener Program, and became director of the Berks County Cooperative Extension Program in 1991.

In 2000 she became the first woman elected as a Berks County Commissioner, and she later served as president of 10,000 Friends of Pennsylvania and as dean of agricultural and environmental sciences at Delaware Valley College.
In the Senate she spearheaded 2016 efforts to research and cultivate industrial hemp and worked on the 2019 Farm Bill, which made a $24 million investment in the state's agricultural industry.

She was named administrator of the Senate Democratic Caucus in 2021, serves on the Appropriations, Game & Fisheries, and Health and Human Services committees, and is a co-founder and co-chair of the Pennsylvania Women's Health Caucus and the Pennsylvania Jewish Legislative Caucus.
